2026So Far: The Trade Machine Is Back OnIn progress · 2 weeks in · Birdgangflyeagles and Bjspjs4 both 4-0

Two weeks in, and with the league-median game counting as a second result each week, two teams haven't lost yet. Here's where things stand.

43transactions so far
3trades, all involving Bjspjs4
4-0Birdgangflyeagles & Bjspjs4
55.74giJ03's Week 2

Bjspjs4 is back at it

Bjspjs4 has made all three trades of the season so far, all in Week 2. He sent Tee Higgins to Goldminers1 for Drake London, got Carnell Tate from dahlilama for RJ Harvey, then flipped Tate to MayockJr for Jacory Croskey-Merritt, all in the same week. The result so far is 4-0, from the 8th draft slot, the same one every champion has picked from.

The quiet man leads the league

Birdgangflyeagles hasn't made a single move this season. He's 4-0 and leads the league with 267 points, including a 143.60 in Week 2 that beat MayockJr by 71.68. Last year he made seven moves and went 3-11. Two years ago he made twelve and was the #1 seed. Doing nothing has now produced a 1 seed, a 6 seed, a last-place finish, and a 4-0 start.

Early trouble

Sleon1000, the two-time #1 seed, is 1-3. Rookie giJ03 is 0-4 and put up 55.74 in Week 2, the third-lowest score in league history. juleon8 is 2-2 overall but has won both head-to-head games, which keeps his record 10-game win streak alive.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. Off to a 3-1 start at 125.5 a week.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the two highest scores ever. Two playoff trips, no ring, and 8 straight head-to-head wins.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: Leads the league in points at 4-0 without making a single move. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.juleon8: Riding a league-record 10-game head-to-head win streak. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs and 1-3 this year.
cases.Bjspjs4: 4-0 with three trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 144.08 in Week 2. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut. Nobody has film on him.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 0-4, averaging 73 points a week. The field.
